-- First, let me check if Garden exists as a category and what fiscal periods exist for FY2024/25
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
ORDER BY fiscal_period;

-- Check for Garden category
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM dim_product WHERE category = 'Garden' LIMIT 1;

-- Garden net sales by period, FY2024/25 P7-P12, as-was
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND n.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
